diagnosis: The FetchLeadDetails method queries GORM for a sales lead using only the lead_id string. In this shared database model, leads across distinct commercial clients are stored in the same table. A sales agent from one tenant can view competitor leads, contact emails, deal sizes, and contract negotiation stages.

GET /crm/leads/lead_77341 HTTP/1.1
Host: enterprise-crm.cloudapp.net
Authorization: Bearer rep_token_acme
Accept: application/json
